definitions: The belief that human beings are the central or most important entity in the universe.
The viewpoint that human beings are the most significant species on Earth and that all other life forms exist for human benefit.
An interpretation of reality exclusively in terms of human values and experience.
examples: The debate often centers on anthropocentrism versus ecocentrism.
Critics argue that anthropocentrism has led to environmental degradation.
Ancient philosophies sometimes exhibited strong anthropocentrism.
